faqs.question: What is the best time to take the troponin I serum test?
faqs.answer: This test is performed immediately when you have heart attack symptoms. It's an emergency diagnostic tool, not a routine checkup. Doctors often order repeated tests over 6-24 hours to track changes in your troponin levels.
